mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 2% for two consecutive months reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2% and remains above for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns show no statistically significant negative relationship with FEDFUNDS change (p > 0.05 in OLS).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 monthly increases triggers a confidence effect that accelerates S&P 500 gains over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than during periods of similar labor momentum but negative SPX 20-day returns (Granger causality rejected).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (GDPC1) below 105 indicates weakening aggregate demand, which predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: early-cycle soft landing turning into contraction
failure_condition: GDPC1 contraction reverses or fails to predict negative 5-day SPX returns (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of industrial production (INDPRO) above 106 coupled with a decline in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) suggests supply-side relaxation, amplifying S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 106 for 2 consecutive months AND CPIAUCSL < previous month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns show no significant correlation with the combined INDPRO-CPIAUCSL signal (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in the federal funds rate turns positive, it indicates tightening and reduces the present value of equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than during prior positive FEDFUNDS trend periods (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.5% coincides with a positive feedback loop where investor confidence rises, pushing S&P 500 forward returns to the positive over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher than during comparable UNRATE expansion phases (Granger causality rejected).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of declining retail sales (not available in the provided proxies - skip this one and instead use a valid proxy) - instead: A sustained decline in housing starts (not available) - instead use: A 3-month decline in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 233 suggests demand is outpacing supply, predicting positive 5-day SPX returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than during prior CPIAUCSL declines (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When both industrial production (INDPRO) and consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) show simultaneous divergence (INDPRO rising while CPIAUCSL stagnates), it signals a supply-side imbalance that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increasing while CPIAUCSL remains flat for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than during comparable divergent INDPRO-CPIAUCSL patterns (p > 0.05).
